items.name: SilentShout Music Impact
items.description: The worship arm, and the gathering the network is built around. Worship held long enough for something to shift, across editions since 2014.

items.name: SilentShout School of Music Ministry
items.description: Where musical competence and spiritual formation are taught as one subject — cohorts, live teaching, mentoring and the Young Music Ministers Summit.

items.name: We Evangelise Project
items.description: The outreach arm, run with non-profit and faith-based mission partners — the Gospel, relief and practical skill acquisition carried into rural communities.

items.name: The 5AM Tribe
items.description: A community of saints committed to praying daily at 5am for at least an hour — one of the network's spiritual formation pillars.
